capabilities: Create and edit themes in a visual editor
Assign palette colors to semantic UI variables
Switch themes via commands or hotkeys
Import and export themes as JSON
Rename color variables with automatic reference updates
disambiguation: Despite the CodeSplash name, it themes the Obsidian interface and editor, not code blocks.
extras: Fetches release notes over the network after plugin updates (no vault data sent); manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Building an Obsidian theme normally requires hand-writing CSS snippets or theme files, and switching between custom looks is cumbersome.
summary: Visual theme editor that lets users create, manage, and switch custom Obsidian color themes built from a two-layer palette and assignment system.
